name: cp_sat_integer
steps: declare integer variables X (channel X effectiveness) and Y (channel Y effectiveness) with non-negative domains
encode budget_limit: X + Y <= 2000 and effort_req: 3*X - 2*Y >= 500
minimize the linear cost 50*X + 100*Y with OR-Tools CP-SAT as an exact integer solver
report optimal objective value and the (X, Y) allocation

name: milp_direct_highs
steps: declare non-negative integer variables X and Y
encode budget_limit: X + Y <= 2000 and effort_req: 3*X - 2*Y >= 500
minimize 50*X + 100*Y with the HiGHS MIP solver at zero MIP gap
report proven optimum and the (X, Y) allocation

name: bounded_enumeration
steps: derive a finite integer upper bound for Y from the two linear constraints
for each integer Y, derive the feasible integer interval for X and evaluate its cost-monotone boundary
track the feasible (X, Y) pair minimizing 50*X + 100*Y
report the best pair and its cost as the optimum
